text: File:.png Shows an item with its icon (with the grade border), its name in the grade colour and an optional amount. Usage by item IDThe name, grade and icon all come from the game data, so the item ID is all you need. {{Item|ItemID=135135|500}} the item with ID 135135, amount 500 {{Item|ItemID=135135}} no amount ItemID (also written id): the item ID, for example from https://aa-classic.com/database/items The first unnamed value is then the amount (or write amount=500). size (optional): the icon size in pixels. The default is 22, so the icon fits in a line of text; use size=32 or larger for lists and boxes. grade (optional): overrides the item's own grade, for example the grade a recipe asks for. The data comes from the data pages on the wiki (made by sync_wiki_data.py), so no request is needed. An item that is not stored yet is fetched live (two requests) until the script has been run for it. Hover: when the pointer rests on the icon or the name, the item's tooltip card (Template:Tooltip) opens below it. It is shown only for items that the sync script has stored (so it never makes extra requests). The card opens to the right of the item (towards the middle of the page for normal text); tip=left opens it to the left instead, for items at the right edge, for example in an infobox. tip=no turns it off for one item, for example in a crowded list. On phones the card opens below the item. "Obtained from": the hover card ends with where the item comes from. The crafts and quests that give the item are filled in automatically (every quest links to the aa-classic.com quest database; more than 5 show "and N more" and the whole list opens when the pointer rests on it). Under "Other" come the lines typed in by editors: write them once for the item on Module:Data/Sources, or add source= here for this use only, with lines separated by ;;, for example Abyssal ShardMaterialGrandAbyssal ShardUntradeableIt warms your hand with demonic, abyssal magic. html:
File:.png  Shows an item with its icon (with the grade border), its name in the grade colour and an optional amount.

Usage by item ID The name, grade and icon all come from the game data, so the item ID is all you need. 

{{Item|ItemID=135135|500}}      the item with ID 135135, amount 500
{{Item|ItemID=135135}}          no amount
  • ItemID (also written id): the item ID, for example from https://aa-classic.com/database/items
  • The first unnamed value is then the amount (or write amount=500).
  • size (optional): the icon size in pixels. The default is 22, so the icon fits in a line of text; use size=32 or larger for lists and boxes.
  • grade (optional): overrides the item's own grade, for example the grade a recipe asks for.
  • The data comes from the data pages on the wiki (made by sync_wiki_data.py), so no request is needed. An item that is not stored yet is fetched live (two requests) until the script has been run for it.
  • Hover: when the pointer rests on the icon or the name, the item's tooltip card (Template:Tooltip) opens below it. It is shown only for items that the sync script has stored (so it never makes extra requests). The card opens to the right of the item (towards the middle of the page for normal text); tip=left opens it to the left instead, for items at the right edge, for example in an infobox. tip=no turns it off for one item, for example in a crowded list. On phones the card opens below the item.
  • "Obtained from": the hover card ends with where the item comes from. The crafts and quests that give the item are filled in automatically (every quest links to the aa-classic.com quest database; more than 5 show "and N more" and the whole list opens when the pointer rests on it). Under "Other" come the lines typed in by editors: write them once for the item on Module:Data/Sources, or add source= here for this use only, with lines separated by ;;, for example  Abyssal ShardMaterialGrandAbyssal ShardUntradeableIt warms your hand with demonic, abyssal magic. It can be obtained in dungeons.Used for equipment crafting.Obtained fromCraftingDisintegration: Abyssal CrystalQuest rewards (25)Greater Dungeon Master50 Shades of LevelingHidden DangersThe Mistsong MastersGargantuan Guardiansand 20 moreQuest rewards (25)Greater Dungeon Master50 Shades of LevelingHidden DangersThe Mistsong MastersGargantuan GuardiansGreater Bounty: Arkanis the DestroyerGreater Bounty: Marmas the ReaperGreater Bounty: Lost Prince HieronimusGreater Bounty: Okape the SlayerGreater Bounty: Salphira's Avatar AkmitAchieve Lv50Bounty: Captain JergantBounty: Rowan AlexanderBounty: HalnaakBounty: Recordkeeper WynnBounty: Sirothe the InfernalBounty: DahutaWeekend Bounty: DahutaGreater Bounty: Ancient Titan MusperosaBounty: Ancient Titan MusperosaBounty: Marmas the ReaperBounty: Lost Prince HieronimusBounty: Okape the SlayerBounty: Salphira's Avatar AkmitBounty: Arkanis the DestroyerOtherDropped by dungeon bossesSold by Dungeon Vendor. source=no hides the whole part.
  • If the data cannot be found at all, nothing is shown (an invisible comment is left in the page source).

Usage by item name 

{{Item|Hay Bale|Basic|3}}      name, grade, amount (the icon is the file named after the item)
  • icon (optional): the game's own icon file name, for example icon_item_3400.png, used by the automatic templates.

Needs Module:IconName and Template:Grade; the ID form also needs External Data, and the hover card needs Template:Tooltip with Template:Item/styles.css.

No description.
